// About this file: Registers the QA platform MCP server with GitHub Copilot Chat in Agent mode.
VS Code starts the process itself and speaks to it over stdio, so this is a
separate instance from the 'mcp' container in docker-compose.yml.
1. the backend must be running   -> docker compose up -d api
2. you must exist as a user      -> docker compose exec api python -m app.cli add-user --email you@example.com --name 'Your Name'
3. you must hold a project grant -> docker compose exec api python -m app.cli grant-access --email you@example.com --project ABC
Then open Copilot Chat, switch to Agent mode, and ask: what are the

inputs.description: INTERNAL_API_TOKEN from your .env. VS Code stores it in its secret storage, not in this file.
